capture.setup: docker run --name fxlab-d-maria --hostname mariadb-lab mariadb:11.4; schemas shop (orders 8000 rows, customers 500) and hr (staff 40); discovery account openmap@'%' (mysql_native_password) with SELECT, PROCESS, SLAVE MONITOR, BINLOG MONITOR.
capture.command: Recording TCP proxy (lab-only Go program inside apps/collectors, removed after capture) between the OpenMap database collector's real prober (Collector.Collect from the Windows host, engine option set, port = proxy) and the container's 127.0.0.1-published port; every byte each side sent is stored in order, one file per TCP connection, with wire.json indexing the direction, offset and length of each contiguous segment. Target 127.0.0.1:53307 (mariadb-lab), user openmap, mysql_native_password, no TLS.

files.name: wire.json
files.description: Index of the recorded conversation: per connection, ordered client/server segments (offset, length) into the .bin file

files.name: wire/conn-1.bin
files.description: Raw TCP bytes of connection 1 exactly as exchanged (client and server segments concatenated in order)

redactions.what: client HandshakeResponse41 auth-response (20-byte mysql_native_password scramble of the lab account password) at byte offset 140
redactions.replacement: 20 zero bytes (same length; replay does not read client content)
